explication: The repository provides three progressively advanced C++ ray tracers from the book series. In each, the executable’s main function assembles a scene and configures a camera; the camera traces sampled rays through that scene and writes a PPM image to standard output. The later versions add textures, more geometry and participating media, then importance sampling and explicit light sampling. The graph emphasizes these runtime paths and major capabilities visible in the tree; some advanced feature wiring is inferred only from the documented book progression and filenames, so uncertain call edges are omitted.
